# Conversion Prompt Module

- Read `.github/skills/cql-to-drl/SKILL.md` and `.github/skills/cql-to-drl/cql-to-drl-guide.md` before conversion.
- Read `artifacts/extraction/<ticket-id>.json` and `artifacts/plan/<ticket-id>.md`.
- Generate one DRL per changed CQL source file. If the CQL basename already starts with `mips`, keep it (e.g., `mips338.cql` → `mips338.drl`). If the basename is a bare number, prefix with `mips` (e.g., `488.cql` → `mips488.drl`).
- If `examples/drl-reference/year2026/` contains DRLs, align rule names, shared-file handling, and coding patterns to those examples.
- Match reference fact style:
	- Use platform domain facts (`Program`, `Patient`, `ClinicalActivity`, `Diagnosis`, `QdmDatatype` as appropriate).
	- Use `EncounterDenominator` for denominator handoff.
	- Add standard reference imports and `global PatientResults controlSet;`.
	- Restrict `declare` usage to marker/helper facts only.
- Rule name format is mandatory: `Year<year>.Mips<measure>.<PopulationOrOutcome>[.<OptionOrQualifier>][.EMR[.Org|.Group|.Provider]]`.
- Marker declare format is mandatory: `Year<year>Mips<measure><Purpose>EMR`.
- Do not use ticket id or sequence style names in rules or markers (for example `1048701_denominator_001`, `T1048701_*`).
- Do not generate synthetic wrapper facts (for example `<measure>Context`, `<measure>Evidence`, `<measure>EmrOutput`).
- EMR rules must be fire-once guarded and must emit org/group/provider outputs when pattern requires attribution fan-out.
- For denominator option `all` patterns, emit all expected denominator evidence EMR rows (not only encounter status).
- Create mapping with columns: CQL Source, DRL Rule, Status, Guide Reference, Notes.
- Include explicit assumption rows for unresolved shared-library pathways.
- Do not produce placeholder-only DRL output.
- Run `python scripts/validate_conversion_artifacts.py --ticket <ticket-id>` before marking conversion complete.
